title: This MP migrates the Ruby package rubygems-integration to use the newer Minitest API.
description: This MP migrates the Ruby package rubygems-integration to use the newer Minitest API.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 00c3676..01612f1 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+rubygems-integration (1.18ubuntu2) oracular; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/p/fix-ruby-3.3-minitest.patch: add a patch to migrate Ruby
+    Minitest
+
+ -- Zixing Liu <zixing.liu@canonical.com>  Thu, 29 Aug 2024 13:34:16 -0600
+
 rubygems-integration (1.18ubuntu1) oracular; urgency=medium
 
   * d/control/tests: Define env var MT_COMPAT for compatibility
diff --git a/debian/patches/fix-ruby-3.3-minitest.patch b/debian/patches/fix-ruby-3.3-minitest.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..12774f1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/fix-ruby-3.3-minitest.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+Description: Migrate Ruby tests to Minitest 5.x
+Author: Zixing Liu <zixing.liu@canonical.com>
+Forwarded: no
+Last-Update: 2024-08-29
+---
+diff --git a/spec/rubygems_integration_spec.rb b/spec/rubygems_integration_spec.rb
+index b3c00f9..17e0516 100644
+--- a/spec/rubygems_integration_spec.rb
++++ b/spec/rubygems_integration_spec.rb
+@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
+ require 'minitest/autorun'
+ 
+-class RubygemsIntegrationSpec < MiniTest::Spec
++class RubygemsIntegrationSpec < Minitest::Spec
+   ARCH = RbConfig::CONFIG['arch']
+   RUBY_API_VERSION = RbConfig::CONFIG['ruby_version']
+ 
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e2b841c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/series
